source_text: Critics counter that these benefits are overstated or achievable through non-invasive means like hygiene education, and that ethical principles of non-maleficence and justice preclude routine intervention on healthy minors, likening it to other forms of medically unnecessary genital modification rejected in contemporary human rights frameworks.
